description.en: Continuous lava crust surrounds a deep trunk-shaped negative cavity with chilled lining and subdued bark relief.
description.zh: 连续熔岩地壳包围深树干状负形空腔，内壁具冷凝衬层及低起伏树皮印痕。

scientific_scope.en: Generic geological process/form concept informed by published examples, including modern analogs. No geological period, named site or coexisting ecosystem is asserted. Rocks and landforms are original simplified geometry. The cited analogs are mostly young; a tree-bearing landscape is required, and no Mesozoic occurrence is asserted.

sources.title: Lava Trees and Tree Molds
sources.supports: Tree molds are cavities within a non-deflated lava flow after the engulfed tree burns away; distinct from exposed lava-tree columns. Modern process analog only.

sources.title: Volcanoes and Fossils
sources.supports: Chilled basalt can preserve bark molds and a hollow cylinder; examples are mostly young, so no Mesozoic locality or long fossil range is inferred.
